title: How to Build a Customer Portal With AI (No Developer Required)
summary: Build a branded customer portal where clients track projects, submit requests, download files, and view invoices — without a developer. Step-by-step with AI.
body_markdown: No. Describe what you want in plain language. Blink generates the database, the views, the auth, and the hosting. You adjust via conversation: "make the status dropdown include 'In Review' and 'Delivered'" and Blink updates it.
